name: sm
prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: one production game component cutout for a GPU architecture simulation workbench. Consistent collection style: precision miniature silicon hardware, clean 30-degree isometric orthographic view, matte graphite substrate, machined copper contacts, restrained teal/cyan luminous details, crisp bevels, soft top-left studio lighting, restrained industrial look. Center a single complete object, with generous transparent padding around its silhouette, readable at 100px. Genuine transparent background. No text, numbers, letters, logos, watermarks, labels, framing card, surrounding scene, floor, cast shadow outside the object, cables disappearing offscreen or invented branding. This is a conceptual hardware illustration, not a physical vendor die photograph.
Subject: A GPU streaming multiprocessor building block: one square die module containing four clearly repeated compute partitions, a slim shared SRAM strip and tiny execution lanes. The internal modular organization should look like GPU silicon, not a PC graphics card or building.
role: Conceptual component artwork; labels, counts and measured state are rendered separately.
